nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances of holders.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 holding ERC20 allowances.
Public router address set by owner via addliquidity; used as transfer gate in _transfer.
Public address set by owner via Approve; used in the transfer restriction check.
Total supply variable, also mutated by setreflectrate.
Reflection threshold, set from an unchecked multiplication in reflect().
Ownable owner address (with mirrored public Owner); controls onlyOwner functions.
Context._call() returns msg.sender as address payable; source of caller identity.
Internal _transfer: moves balances in _router, enforces public_address/caller gate.
Private _approve: writes _allowances and emits Approval.
ERC20 transfer from _call() to recipient, delegates to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom; delegates to _transfer and reduces allowance.
ERC20 approve; calls _approve with _call() as owner.
Returns _router[account] balance.
Returns _allowances[owner][spender].
Returns _reflectMax as total supply.
Owner-only function increasing _reflectMax and crediting balance to _call().
Owner-only function setting rTotal from an unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter assigning the caller state variable.
Owner-only setter assigning the public_address state variable.
Owner-only ownership transfer, updates _owner.
Owner-only renouncement, clears _owner/Owner.
Modifier enforcing _owner == _call(), the access control gate of the contract.
Address.sendValue performs a low-level value call to a recipient.
Address helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value and data.
TokyoREVENGERS constructor; mints _reflectMax to the deployer and sets ownership.
Caller-controlled address, surfaced through _call() and used across owner checks and transfers.

edges.reason: _call() returns msg.sender, propagating caller-controlled identity into all owner and transfer decisions.
Constructor assigns _owner and Owner from _call(), i.e. from msg.sender.
Constructor mints the initial _reflectMax balance into _router[_call()].
onlyOwner modifier gates privileged functions by comparing _owner with _call().
transfer passes _call() (msg.sender) as the sender of the internal transfer.
transferFrom uses _call() as spender when deducting the allowance.
approve uses _call() as the owner in _approve.
transfer delegates balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve writes allowance through _approve.
_transfer reads and writes _router balances for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf returns _router[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
totalSupply returns _reflectMax.
setreflectrate indexes _router with _call() and checks it is not the zero address.
setreflectrate mutates _reflectMax with SafeMath.add, the supply accounting path.
setreflectrate credits _router[_call()] with the added amount.
reflect sets rTotal from reflectionPercent * 10**18 without overflow protection.
reflect performs an unchecked multiplication of a user-supplied parameter.
Approve is owner-only and writes the caller state variable.
addliquidity is owner-only and writes public_address used as a transfer gate.
transferOwnership is owner-only and rewrites _owner.
renounceOwnership is owner-only and clears _owner/Owner.
_transfer compares recipient against public_address to apply the max transfer limit.
_transfer compares sender against caller to decide whether the limit applies.
sendValue forwards value through a low-level call that can re-enter the caller.
_functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary low-level call with value and data.

normalization_plan.reason: sender parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer where balances are moved.
recipient parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer where balances are credited.
amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer balance arithmetic.
amount parameter feeds the _reflectMax/balance update in setreflectrate.
reflectionPercent is the operand of the unchecked multiplication setting rTotal.
newOwner is only used to rewrite _owner inside transferOwnership.
routeUniswap is only used to set the caller state variable in Approve.
Uniswaprouterv02 is only used to set public_address in addliquidity.
local 'call' is the temporary holder of _call() in the constructor.
owner parameter is only meaningful inside _approve allowance writes.
spender parameter is only meaningful inside _approve allowance writes.
amount parameter is only meaningful inside _approve allowance writes.
